summary: PepGen Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a firm-commitment underwritten follow-on offering of 25,000,000 shares of common stock at a public offering price of $5.00 per share, grossing $125.0 million ($117.5 million net of discounts before expenses). Underwriting discounts are $0.30 per share. The syndicate, led by Leerink Partners, Stifel and Guggenheim Securities with Oppenheimer, H.C. Wainwright and others, holds a 30-day option for up to 3,750,000 additional shares. Closing is expected on or about November 13, 2026; the November 10 closing price was $4.61. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and pricing versus market.
